status: derived (masses, thresholds, symmetry stability) + estimate (gravitational decay rates)

masses_GeV.formulas: m_X = gX v, m_h = sqrt(2 lam_phi) v, m_D = sqrt(mD0^2 + hD^2 v^2)

broken_phase_vertices.hhh: lam_phi v h^3 (Feynman 6 lam_phi v = 60 GeV)
broken_phase_vertices.note: symmetric phase (phi = 0) has no cubic vertex: number changes only by 2->4 there (thermal_potential)

stability.verdict: no non-gravitational decay; gravitational lifetime >> age
stability.reason: h -> X Xbar needs m_h > 200 GeV, h -> D D needs m_h > 201.0 GeV (both closed); Higgs and other portals are zero at mu_0 and stay zero under non-gravitational running (hidden_heating)

naive_dimensional.note: m_h^5/M_P^4 with no small factors: generous upper estimate of any gravitational 2-body rate

loop_h_to_graviton_pair.note: heavy-loop low-energy theorem; m_h^2/(4 m_X^2) = 0.5 so O(1)-O(10) form-factor uncertainty; tree-level h -> gg vanishes for minimal coupling (no h-linear vertex; h R term vanishes on shell)

xi_trace_coupling.note: xi_phi = 0 at mu_0 by matching; |xi_eff| ~ 1e-5..1e-3 band covers running + finite parts

h_decay.verdict: every estimate gives tau_h > 1e36 s >> 4.4e17 s: h is a cosmologically stable relic species of the action

dim5_Z2odd_phiFF_over_MP.note: NOT in the action (Z2_phi exact by postulate P4); such an operator would also bias the walls

dim6_phi2FF_over_MP2.note: zero at mu_0 by matching; shown for scale
